$comment: Classification of Cloudflare/Vercel workspaces. Checked by tools/check-workers.mjs. railsBacked: OpenNext apps that fetch from Rails — they own a src/lib/rails-client.ts copy and declare the VPC binding in env.vpc ONLY (pnpm preview:vpc; development and test carry no transport, and the top level — which IS production — carries none until a production VPC Service exists). contentSurface: OpenNext apps that do not talk to Rails and must carry no VPC binding at all. standalone: Hono apex workers, no Rails. external: Vercel-hosted, no wrangler config.
$vpcDevelopmentServiceIdComment: The development VPC Service, bound to the development tunnel (1d501e9a-62f7-4c0d-ba5e-a26e3f10088f) and terminating on core.app.localhost:3000. It is NOT a production resource; production must never point at it. Verify with `wrangler vpc service get <id>`.
